intent.plan_step: Warm-up: recall halves and quarters (which is bigger and why)
Announce the objective: add fractions with the same denominator
Explain with fraction strips (shade 1/5 then 2/5 more, count fifths)
Address the common mistake 1/5 + 2/5 = 3/10 (do not add denominators)
Model the worked example 1/5 + 2/5 step by step on the board
Guided practice with the whole class (2/8 + 3/8 and 1/6 + 4/6)
Pair activity: 3 problems from the card solved with a partner using strips
Peer checking: swap cards with another pair and check answers
Whole-class check: mini whiteboards (3/9 + 4/9) and thumbs up/sideways
Recap: a pupil states the rule in one sentence
Exit ticket: one question each (2/6 + 3/6), collected by the teacher
Homework: workbook page 42, questions 1-5
Extension (optional, if time permits): pupils write their own story problem

intent.plan_step: Warm-up: what does a plant need; where have you seen plants
Announce the objective: parts of a plant and their jobs
Show a real plant out of its pot and have pupils name the parts
Explain roots: hold the plant and take in water
Celery-in-coloured-water demonstration: the stem carries water
Explain leaves make food from sunlight; the flower makes seeds
Pupils label the board diagram (roots, stem, leaves, flower)
Group matching activity: part cards to job cards
Whole-class check: teacher points, class calls out the job
Exit slip: one part and its job, collected
Homework: draw and label a plant from home
Extension (optional, if time permits): plant a bean seed in a cup
intent.comment: optional move not attempted; excluded from the denominator
